page: Amazon Web Services m7gd.medium is a general-purpose instance powered by a dedicated 64-bit ARM Neoverse-V1 core running at 2.6 GHz under the AWS Nitro System. The configuration provides 1 dedicated physical core, 1 vCPU, and 4.0 GB of memory, preserving a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory balance. Bundled local hardware includes a 59 GB NVMe SSD ephemeral drive and a baseline network throughput of 1 Gbps, with hardware-accelerated AES cryptography natively supported.

Benchmark assessments demonstrate middle-tier single-core processing capabilities, reflected in a Geekbench single-core score of 1430.0 and a stress-ng single-core result of 1516.99. Multi-core performance ratings sit within the lower percentiles across testing suites due to the physical constraint of a single CPU core. Memory subsystems exhibit 29.61 GB/s uncached read bandwidth and 10.93 GB/s uncached write bandwidth, delivering 1.71 million operations per second during Redis SET testing and 1.89 GB/s throughput in static web serving benchmarks.

The instance delivers a cost-efficient profile for tasks that need dedicated execution without hyper-threading contention while benefiting from integrated NVMe storage. Because high-speed local disk capacity is included directly, it avoids additional block storage overhead for temporary files. Suitable applications include lightweight web serving, edge caching, continuous integration runners, log processing, and distributed microservices with modest memory footprints.
description: Amazon Web Services m7gd.medium is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the ARM64 architecture using an AWS Graviton-generation Neoverse-V1 processor clocked at 2.6 GHz. Operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the instance provides 1 dedicated physical core, 1 vCPU, and 4.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM balance. Bundled local storage includes a 59 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, complemented by a 1 Gbps baseline network capability. Synthetic performance evaluations show mid-tier single-core compute output, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 1430.0, while aggregate multi-core metrics sit in the lowest percentiles due to the single-core configuration. Memory bandwidth yields 29.61 GB/s uncached read performance, supporting workloads such as Redis operations at 1.71 million queries per second. With integrated high-speed local disk and dedicated single-core throughput, the m7gd.medium fits entry-level web services, edge caching, light batch processing, and continuous integration tasks requiring low-latency scratch storage.
